expected_response.evidence_basis: diagnostic-only pair-kernel/moment effects, mixed-sign landmark effects, non-monotone temporal trends, modest teacher overlap
expected_response.expected_direction: no change to effective numerical parameters; incumbent pointcloud_delta_A 1.0 A, teacher_neighbors 4, mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 preserved

failure_modes: Selecting a pointcloud_delta_A from pair-kernel diagnostics would treat a diagnostic feature as a term the executing scalar does not contain.
Selecting a region_index from mixed-sign softmin/occupancy effects could trade one component against another with no net favorable endpoint evidence.
A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would rest on non-monotone trends and rejected polynomial fits, and would misinterpret a coordinate reward as a trajectory velocity force.
Changing teacher_neighbors would treat a neighbor count as a distance bandwidth and rely on only modest teacher overlap/correlation.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation, not a research condition.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The registered pointcloud curvature alternatives (0.5, 1.0, 2.0 A) are not separated by any supplied evidence: the short-range pair-kernel endpoint effects (pair_kernel_1.5 z 0.562, pair_kernel_2.5 0.631, pair_kernel_3.5 0.540, pair_kernel_5.0 0.319, pair_kernel_7.0 -0.485) are diagnostic moment summaries, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so they cannot select delta. Landmark softmin and occupancy effects have opposite signs within the same region (e.g. landmark_00_softmin -0.481 vs landmark_00_occupancy3 0.545; landmark_06_softmin 0.294 vs landmark_06_occupancy5 -0.365), so no region_index has an unambiguously favorable net endpoint effect. Temporal edits rest on non-monotone observed-node trends (polynomial_accepted false, sign_changes 4-10, strong_sign_conflicts 1-14, extrapolation_allowed false) and the curve-fidelity audit rejects Legendre runtime use; registered temporal recipes are coordinate rewards, not velocity forces. Teacher-neighbor count is a count, not a bandwidth, and the information audit shows only modest teacher overlap (top4 0.470) and chosen-teacher score correlation (0.102), so no neighbor-count change is defensible. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because no supplied evidence provides a defensible expected advantage for any registered bounded edit, retaining the incumbent is the affinity-first choice; the negative joint rigid-motion residual associations and the negative selection-innovation/observed-child-score-gain association are descriptive and do not establish a causal benefit.
